title: Nikkes
summary: Hero towers: deployed free into a Nikke slot, upgraded and evolved with gold like towers, each with a Burst Skill you aim yourself.

sections.title: Marian
sections.sub: Marian is deployed to the front line. With a rapid attack speed, she specializes in targeting single enemies. By using her Burst Skill, she can provide instant firepower support to a certain location.
sections.note: Unlocks: Lv. 3 from EX-2; Awakened Marian from EX-3.
